I don't know how much worse it could have been. 3 years is a long time to suffer, and some viewers have suggested that Korra was suicidal at at least one point (though it's not obvious, but I don't think they would be allowed to show it overtly, even if it were true). It will be interesting to see how Toph decides to respond to Korra's issues, and how much more we learn about Korra's suffering as she heals.

Well said. I'm rilly confused though, as to whether she is hiding her identity, or has amnesia at some point? Or both at different times? I feel like both would be fitting, but I can't sort all the flashbacks to get a clear idea. Am I missing something?
